candidates.title: OREA Publications
candidates.description: The Office of Revenue and Economic Analysis (OREA) is a Division within the New Jersey Department of the Treasury.  OREA maintains a small staff of economists, research professionals, and support staff that provides data, projections and analyses of State tax revenues and tax policy. The Office assists in preparing annual publications such as the Governor's Budget Message, the Budget in Brief, the Appropriations Act, the Annual Tax Expenditure Report, and various other documents. OREA’s online publications include numerous statistical reports for major State tax revenues such as the Gross Income Tax, the Corporation Business Tax, the Sales and Use Tax, the Alcohol Beverage Tax, and more. In addition, OREA occasionally publishes specialized informational primers on various tax topics.
